title: Test: computeNextEligible returns null when there's no minimum interval
description: computeNextEligible(givenAt, null) must return null -- a medication with no configured minimum interval never blocks a next dose.
acceptance_criteria: @Test fun computeNextEligible_returnsNull_whenNoMinInterval() calls DoseTimingCalculator.computeNextEligible(1_000_000L, null) and asserts the result is null via assertNull
